meta.title: SupoClip Creator Program: Earn {percent}% for {months} Months
meta.description: Make videos about SupoClip and earn {percent}% of what your audience pays for their first {months} months, paid to your bank through Stripe. Your audience gets 20% off their first 3 months.

hero.title: Make videos about SupoClip. Earn {percent}% for {months} months.
hero.body: Posting Shorts, Reels or TikToks about clipping, podcasting or creator tools? Get your own code. Your audience saves 20%, you earn {percent}% of what they pay for their first {months} months, and you get SupoClip Pro free while you're in the program.

video.name: How the SupoClip creator program works
video.description: Apply, pick your code, and your audience gets 20% off their first 3 months. Approved creators get SupoClip Pro for free.
video.aria: Creator program explainer: apply, pick your code, and your audience gets 20% off their first 3 months

offer.heading: What everyone gets
offer.earnDetail: Of every payment from people who subscribe with your code, for their first {months} months. That's about ${pro} per Pro subscriber and ${creator} per Creator subscriber. For creators in the US, the UK, Canada, Switzerland and Europe.
offer.youDetail: Pro is normally ${price}/month and includes {limit} hours of video a month. Approved creators get it for free for as long as they're in the program.
offer.youDetailNoLimit: Pro is normally ${price}/month. Approved creators get it for free for as long as they're in the program.
offer.audienceDetail: For their first 3 months on any plan. It works through your link or by typing your code at checkout.

apply.title: Apply
apply.detail: Tell us where you post and pick your code, like MAYA. It takes two minutes.

review.title: We review
review.detail: Every application is reviewed by hand. You get an email either way.

share.title: Share
share.detail: Put your link in your bio or say your code in your videos. Every payment from your audience earns you {percent}% for {months} months.

paid.title: Get paid
paid.detail: Connect Stripe once. Commission is paid to your bank every month, {days} days after each payment.

rules.heading: The rules
rules.sponsored: Mark sponsored posts as such, for example with #ad.
rules.ads: Don't run ads on the SupoClip name or post your code on coupon or deal sites.
rules.incentive: Don't pay or reward people to sign up with your code.
rules.end: We can end the program or remove a creator at any time.

earn.question: How much do I earn?
earn.answer: {percent}% of what each customer who used your link or code pays on the web, for their first {months} months, without tax. A Pro subscriber earns you about ${pro} in that time and a Creator subscriber about ${creator}. Yearly plans count once. Refunded or charged-back payments don't earn commission.

payout.question: How do I get paid?
payout.answer: Through Stripe, straight to your bank account. You set it up once from your creator page: Stripe asks for your name, address, date of birth and bank details. Commission becomes available {days} days after each payment and is paid out monthly once you have ${minimum} or more. Payouts are available in the US, the UK, Canada, Switzerland and Europe.

where.question: Can I earn commission where I live?
where.answer: Commission is paid to creators who live in the US, the UK, Canada, Switzerland and Europe, because that's where Stripe can pay it out. Creators anywhere else can still join: you get SupoClip Pro for free and a code that gives your audience 20% off.

iphone.question: Do subscriptions on iPhone count?
iphone.answer: Not yet. Your audience still gets the discount on iPhone with your code, but commission is earned on subscriptions bought on the web.

followers.question: Is there a minimum number of followers?
followers.answer: No. We look at what you post, not just how many people follow you. Small creators who already make videos about SupoClip are a great fit.

audience.question: What does my audience get?
audience.answer: Anyone who signs up through your link or enters your code at checkout gets 20% off their first 3 months. On the web it works on any plan. On iPhone it applies to Pro: people tap “Have a creator code?” in the app or open your iPhone link.

code.question: Can I pick my own code?
code.answer: Yes. Codes are 3 to 20 letters, numbers or hyphens, and each one can only belong to one creator. The form tells you right away if yours is available.

declined.question: What happens if my application is declined?
declined.answer: You'll get an email, with a note from us when there's something specific. You can apply again after 30 days.

account.question: Do I need a SupoClip account?
account.answer: Yes. The program is tied to your account, so you'll create a free one (or sign in) before applying.

cta.title: Already posting about SupoClip?
cta.body: Apply with a link to your profile and pick your code. If you've made a video about SupoClip, include it.
